QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_6

question.text: Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund (Cat III AIF) is formalising documentation for a structured private-investment block trade. Which of the following are the TWO principal 'definitive agreements' described in Chapter 11 for AIF investments?

answer.text: Prime Brokerage Agreement and Custody Agreement
Investor Charter and Code of Conduct
ISDA Master Agreement and Credit Support Annex
Share Subscription/Purchase Agreement and Shareholders' Agreement

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 273-274 identify the two main definitive agreements as: (1) Share Subscription/Purchase Agreement — between the AIF and investee company, the main transaction document for equity financing; (2) Shareholders' Agreement — inter-se among existing shareholders and the AIF, binding shareholders to agreed rights and obligations. The workbook also notes that the Articles of Association are amended to make the rights enforceable. The Trap: Some options list service-provider contracts that are operational rather than transactional. Governance documents are not transaction closers either. Note: Ensure that the Shareholders' Agreement is reflected in the investee company's Articles of Association so the agreed rights are enforceable.
